## What

Bring up CCSDS 123 in simulation on the path chosen in B1.6 (SHyLoC or HLS),
with a testbench that compares the output against the B1.6 software reference.

## Done when

- [ ] **Bit-exact against the reference on a full 2-minute pass.**
- [ ] The comparison reports the first mismatch with its sample coordinates, not
      just "the files differ".
- [ ] A deliberately injected error is caught by the harness (a harness never
      seen to fail cannot be trusted).
- [ ] A short-pass version runs in CI; the full pass runs on demand.

## Carries over

- `_superseded/V-01-ccsds-golden-model.md`: the comparison harness requirements
  (first-mismatch reporting, injected-error check).
- `_superseded/V-03-full-chain-bench.md`: the round-trip idea, compress then
  decompress and compare with the raw input.
